provenance.implementation: Original independent React/SVG implementation. Source reviewed for contracts only: app/src/kit/bklit/charts/{scatter-chart,candlestick-chart}.tsx, app/src/arc/brush-chart/brush-chart.tsx; reused existing package APIs by reference. No upstream source copied.
provenance.license: MIT for newly authored series source; upstream reference ids confer no redistribution permission. Restricted/unknown references are not imported.
provenance.reviewLimit: curated.json serializes top + more families only; declared family counts exceed its serialized entries. Every serialized family plus every relevant all.json record has a decision. Coverage is behavioral, not visual parity.

reasonDefinitions.basic_area: Existing SisoArea / SisoAreaChart handles numeric series, curves, fill, stack and legend. Behavior coverage only; no upstream visual parity claim.
reasonDefinitions.range: Existing SisoRangeArea handles explicit low/high intervals and optional middle line. Multi-band forecasts remain deferred.
reasonDefinitions.basic_bar: Existing SisoBars / SisoBarChart handles grouped/stacked/percent, signed bars and horizontal layout. Aggregation and specialised overlays remain caller responsibilities.
reasonDefinitions.basic_line: Existing SisoLine / SisoLineChart handles multiple series, curves, dash, dots and legend. No upstream motion/visual parity claim.
reasonDefinitions.brush: Existing SisoLineChart.Brush, SisoAreaChart.Brush and SisoComposedChart.Brush provide index-range zoom; no new duplicate component.
reasonDefinitions.sparkline: Existing ArcSparkline / SisoTrendCard provide compact trends. No terminal glyph rendering parity.
reasonDefinitions.composed: Existing SisoComposedChart combines bars and lines. Area composition, financial indicators and secondary panes are not included.
reasonDefinitions.scatter: New SisoScatter implements numeric XY positioning, area-proportional optional bubble size, named groups, supplied quadrant lines and controlled keyboard/click selection.
reasonDefinitions.waterfall: New SisoWaterfall computes cumulative signed changes and explicit total checkpoints with connectors and full values table. Rejects an invalid bridge instead of silently changing its balances.
reasonDefinitions.candlestick: New SisoCandlestick validates OHLC ordering and provides filled, hollow-up and OHLC tick variants. Categorical ordered observations only.
reasonDefinitions.box: New SisoBoxPlot renders supplied ordered quartiles, whiskers, median and outliers; does not invent a quartile estimation convention.
reasonDefinitions.advanced: Deferred specialised data transform, interaction, aesthetic rendering, domain overlay or animation; base geometry alone is insufficient to claim this family.
reasonDefinitions.financial: Deferred volume panes, moving averages, indicators, live transport, continuous time scale and trading interaction; SisoCandlestick is an OHLC-only baseline.
reasonDefinitions.not_chart: Deferred non-chart or ambiguous classifier match (icons, progress bars, layout, map masks, text/image scatter); no data-series behavior assumed from its group label.

groups.mechanism: Existing area, stacking, range band; specialised densities/streams deferred
Add computed signed waterfall to existing bar variants
Existing line, sparkline and zoom brush; specialised annotations/stream transport deferred
Add validated OHLC candles/ticks to existing bar+line composition

verification: Strict TypeScript compiler API check passed with existing main app React types

SSR assertion scenarios passed: bubble area, selection contract, duplicate ids, signed balances/totals, invalid bridge rejection, OHLC and quartile validation, extreme finite scale values, four empty states
limits: No brush duplicate; existing compound brush remains index based
No volume pane, trading terminal, log axis, regression, histogram binning, beeswarm collision layout, playback, or data streaming transport
SVG uses fixed viewBox with responsive width; browser visual verification belongs to parent inventory integration
Table preserves full labels and values; SVG category labels are thinned and truncated
